title: ProvisionVerifier record installation trusts caller-asserted integrity without admin
description: Correctness/security review: ProvisionVerifier.record() accepts arbitrary replacement fields and a caller-provided integrity_valid=True without verifying an integrity-protected record or requiring the bound admin, despite spec 09 requiring authorized replacement/clear. Separate untrusted parsing from internal integrity verification and admin-authorized install/replace; add forged integrity flag and unauthorized replacement tests.
